decisions.reason: The 4-by-4 grid changes only badge presentation; the eight-badge achievement set was already established and remains unchanged.
Rearranging dashboard badges does not change which referral, ticket, or badge attributes appear in NFT metadata.
The badge-grid decision does not alter NFT cover rendering, ebook links, or View Book behavior.
The source changes dashboard badge layout, not FAQ wording or informational content.
Badge arrangement does not change the rule for displaying only successfully minted NFTs on the dashboard.
The requested grid applies to dashboard badges and does not modify landing-page hero content or layout.
The badge-grid presentation change does not alter About-page descriptions of badges or project mechanics.
The source does not change Mission-page copy about gamification, rewards, or any other mission content.
Dashboard badge rows are independent of the landing-page book-cover size, crop, placement, and visibility rules.
The badge-layout decision does not affect prize payout, collection, or winner-notification behavior.
Changing badge rows does not alter how successfully minted NFTs are counted on the dashboard.
The dashboard badge grid has no effect on PDF.js reader behavior or ebook entry points.
